'''Lasea''' is an [[NPC]] in {{Zone|Dragontail}}. During the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], she tasks the player with obtaining a {{Item|Skeleton Fish}} and {{Item|Flyfish}}.

== Quest ==
After killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} for {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} as part of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], '''Lasea''' will ask the player to bring her 1 {{Item|Skeleton Fish}} and 1 {{Item|Flyfish}}. After they are brought these items, the player will be rewarded with {{Reputation|Barbarian|100}}, and then tasked with speaking to {{NPCSprite|Gris}} to continue the quest.
